_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ems__Bug 24f760d3 — `RestPushService.resolveGhToken` retries ONLY a timed-out `gh auth token` (classified by `code === "ETIMEDOUT"`) with a growing per-attempt limit (15 s, 30 s, 60 s) and names a final timeout as a stall, not an auth failure, keeping exit code 1 and the verdict inside the first 150 chars. M11-M21 are the wrong-but-plausible implementations found by the independent review (W1-W9 and two MEDIUM/LOW findings): each passed the first 13 axes. `red_re` anchors on the `● <suite> › G<n> …` failure header. The harness runs both test files: G21 must mock node:child_process before import. M22-M27 (StageSpecification) are wrong-but-plausible implementations found by the independent review of the specification: each passed all 37 axes of the plan.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/services/RestPushService.ts

M1_no_retry._note: Every timeout is final (main before 24f760d3): the first 15 s miss throws. G3/G22 redden too: the final text reports the attempts MADE ("after 1 attempt"), not the schedule length.

M2_retry_any_error._note: A non-zero exit / missing gh / outside kill is retried like a timeout and finally reported as a stall.

M3_same_limit_every_attempt._note: The schedule is walked but every attempt gets the first limit (15 s three times).

M4_default_runner_ignores_limit._note: The default runner keeps the hardcoded 15 s instead of the per-attempt limit.

M5_stall_named_as_auth._note: The final timeout keeps the old text that sent the capture to auth hypotheses.
M5_stall_named_as_auth.to: `RestPushService: \`gh auth token\` failed — is GitHub CLI installed and authenticated? (${

M6_no_redaction_on_timeout._note: The timeout branch forgets PAT redaction.

M7_gives_up_one_attempt_early._note: Off-by-one: the last attempt of the schedule is never made.

M8_empty_schedule_unguarded._note: An empty schedule calls gh with an undefined limit (no time limit at all).

M9_elapsed_not_measured._note: The elapsed time in the final message is a constant 0 — the measurement for the next failure is lost.

M10_one_attempt_miscounted._note: A one-attempt schedule is reported as "1 attempts".

M11_retry_empty_output._note: Empty output (not authenticated) is retried like a timeout (review W-M11).

M12_classify_by_text._note: Timeout recognised by the word ETIMEDOUT in the message: a non-zero exit whose stderr says ETIMEDOUT is retried and reported as a stall (review W1).

M13_classify_by_signal._note: Timeout recognised by signal SIGTERM: an outside kill is retried, a TERM-ignoring child (SIGPIPE) is not (review W2).

M14_classify_by_errno._note: Timeout recognised by the macOS errno -60: on Linux (-110) nothing is retried (review W7).

M15_elapsed_is_sum_of_limits._note: Elapsed = sum of the limits, a constant, not a measurement (review W4).

M16_auth_check_only_first_attempt._note: A non-timeout after a timeout is retried and finally named a stall — the diagnosis is inverted (review W5).

M17_runner_caps_limit._note: The default runner caps every limit at 15 s: in production all three attempts get 15 s (review W6).

M18_console_noise_on_retry._note: A retry is announced on the console: noise in consumers that parse `--json 2>&1`, unredacted (review W8). G29 reddens too: under jest an un-mocked console method writes to process.stdout (in production console.error goes to stderr).
M18_console_noise_on_retry.to:

M19_env_dropped._note: The default runner drops `env: process.env` — under jest the fake-gh axes would reach the REAL gh (review W9). Real-spawn axes compare by boolean, so no token is printed.

M20_exit_code_shifts._note: A wording that classifyMessage maps to another exit code ("not found" ⇒ FILE_NOT_FOUND): delivery reads rc=1 vs rc=2 differently (review LOW). G3 reddens too: it asserts the same wording.
M20_exit_code_shifts.to: — gh not found in time, not an

M21_keywords_pushed_out_of_head._note: A longer lead-in pushes ETIMEDOUT / the verdict past the 160-char cut of the delivery log (review MEDIUM).
M21_keywords_pushed_out_of_head.to: `RestPushService: \`gh auth token\` (the GitHub CLI call that resolves the token for --token-from-gh) timed out (ETIMEDOUT) after ${

M22_partial_stdout_used._note: A timed-out attempt's partial stdout is taken as the token (review spec P3): a token cut by the kill would be returned instead of retrying.
M22_partial_stdout_used.from: const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);

M23_timeout_needs_null_status._note: A timeout is recognised only with status == null (review spec P4): a TERM-ignoring child that exits by itself (code ETIMEDOUT, status 3) is not retried.
M23_timeout_needs_null_status.to:
(err as { code?: unknown }).code === "ETIMEDOUT" &&
    (err as { status?: unknown }).status == null

M24_geometric_limits._note: Limits derived as first × 2^n instead of read from the schedule (review spec P5): indistinguishable on the default 15/30/60.

M25_stdout_noise_on_retry._note: A retry is announced on stdout (review spec P8): breaks `--json` documents.

M27_wall_clock._note: The wait is measured by the wall clock (review spec, finding on AC6): a clock step back during the attempts reports a negative or shrunk wait.
